subject.title: Crons ejecutaron mensajes de WhatsApp a la 1 AM fuera de horario y no se podían detener

question: Should this issue be resolved by landing the schedule-activation replay fix and tracking emergency stop/delete semantics separately, or should it remain open for one combined operator emergency-stop design?
rationale: The replay bug has a concrete open PR, but making cron remove or gateway stop halt active outbound delivery changes user-facing operator semantics across cron, task cancellation, gateway lifecycle, and channel adapters.

options.title: Land Replay Fix, Split Emergency Stop
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92398 or an equivalent replay fix, then sponsor a narrower product-scoped emergency stop issue for cron delete/gateway stop semantics.

options.title: Require One Combined Fix
options.body: Keep this issue open until one implementation covers restart replay, in-flight cron cancellation, and an outbound delivery kill switch.

options.title: Narrow This Issue To Replay Only
options.body: Declare stop/delete emergency behavior out of scope here and close this issue only after the replay fix lands.

recommendation.title: Land Replay Fix, Split Emergency Stop
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92398 or an equivalent replay fix, then sponsor a narrower product-scoped emergency stop issue for cron delete/gateway stop semantics.
